verdict.rationale: Forter documents genuine official SDKs (3DS iOS/Android via CocoaPods/SPM/Maven, hosted-fields SDK, mobile location SDKs) and, notably for agenticness, an official MCP server that lets AI systems perform actions like reviewing decisions or managing disputes via natural language, with a documented Claude Desktop integration path. This shows a real path for AI-native developers to build against official tooling, but the SDKs themselves are traditional payment/3DS SDKs rather than AI-agent-oriented libraries, and there's no dedicated language-specific SDK (Python/JS) built explicitly for agentic/AI workflows beyond the MCP server. Missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent SDKs/client libraries in common languages, independent developer corroboration of MCP or SDK usage.
